name: Wild Heist at Peacock Manor
review:
A crime story at a gritty country manor, on 17 lines with mystery features in the base game and free spins with symbol transformations and retriggers.

The mystery features keep ordinary spins unpredictable, while the bonus transforms symbols for bigger line wins. High volatility, 8,483x cap, 96.1% RTP. Great atmosphere and a well-told little story.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
